import numpy as np

# Data for "20 years and after" yields from July 1953 through June 1956
# Using a time index starting from 1 for July 1953

yields = [
    3.25,  # 1953-Jul (1)
    3.22,  # 1953-Aug (2)
    3.19,  # 1953-Sep (3)
    3.06,  # 1953-Oct (4)
    3.04,  # 1953-Nov (5)
    2.96,  # 1953-Dec (6)
    2.90,  # 1954-Jan (7)
    2.85,  # 1954-Feb (8)
    2.73,  # 1954-Mar (9)
    2.70,  # 1954-Apr (10)
    2.72,  # 1954-May (11)
    2.70,  # 1954-Jun (12)
    2.62,  # 1954-Jul (13)
    2.60,  # 1954-Aug (14)
    2.64,  # 1954-Sep (15)
    2.65,  # 1954-Oct (16)
    2.68,  # 1954-Nov (17)
    2.68,  # 1954-Dec (18)
    2.77,  # 1955-Jan (19)
    2.92,  # 1955-Feb (20)
    2.92,  # 1955-Mar (21)
    2.92,  # 1955-Apr (22)
    2.91,  # 1955-May (23)
    2.91,  # 1955-Jun (24)
    2.96,  # 1955-Jul (25)
    3.02,  # 1955-Aug (26)
    3.00,  # 1955-Sep (27)
    2.96,  # 1955-Oct (28)
    2.96,  # 1955-Nov (29)
    2.97,  # 1955-Dec (30)
    2.94,  # 1956-Jan (31)
    2.93,  # 1956-Feb (32)
    2.98,  # 1956-Mar (33)
    3.10,  # 1956-Apr (34)
    3.03,  # 1956-May (35)
    2.98,  # 1956-Jun (36)
]

# Create time index (x): 1, 2, 3, ..., 36
x = np.arange(1, len(yields) + 1)
y = np.array(yields)

# Perform OLS regression manually
# y = beta_0 + beta_1 * x
n = len(x)
sum_x = np.sum(x)
sum_y = np.sum(y)
sum_xy = np.sum(x * y)
sum_x2 = np.sum(x ** 2)

# Calculate coefficients
beta_1 = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x ** 2)
beta_0 = (sum_y - beta_1 * sum_x) / n

print(f"OLS Regression Results:")
print(f"Number of observations: {n}")
print(f"Sum of x: {sum_x}")
print(f"Sum of y: {sum_y}")
print(f"Sum of xy: {sum_xy}")
print(f"Sum of x^2: {sum_x2}")
print(f"\nIntercept (beta_0): {beta_0}")
print(f"Slope (beta_1): {beta_1}")
print(f"\nRegression equation: y = {beta_0:.6f} + {beta_1:.6f} * x")

# Now predict for July 1956 which is month 37
x_forecast = 37
y_forecast = beta_0 + beta_1 * x_forecast

print(f"\nForecast for July 1956 (month {x_forecast}):")
print(f"Predicted yield: {y_forecast:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(y_forecast, 3)}")
